scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,worker,receipts,messages -c green,cyan,magenta,yellow "node scripts/run-service.mjs web-dev" "npm run worker" "npm run receipt-worker" "npm run messaging-worker"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typegen -w @tallie/web && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/db/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/receipts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/channels/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/receipt-worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/identity/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/social/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/messaging/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/app-services/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/messaging-worker/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,worker,receipts,messages -c green,cyan,magenta,yellow "node scripts/run-service.mjs web-start" "npm run worker" "npm run receipt-worker" "npm run messaging-worker"
